title: Clinical Data Standards
summary: The standards stack the boards love: HL7 v2 and v3, FHIR, SNOMED CT, LOINC, RxNorm, ICD-10-CM, CPT, and UCUM. What each is for, what granularity it operates at, and which one wins for which use case.
learningOutcomes: Read an HL7 v2 message and identify the segments, fields, and message type.
Read a FHIR resource (Patient, Observation, MedicationRequest) and explain what each element does.
Choose the right terminology (SNOMED, LOINC, RxNorm, ICD-10) for a given clinical use case and defend the choice.
Explain why HL7 v3 lost to FHIR in plain language.
Recognize a UCUM unit string and explain why we standardize units at all.
